Chapter 7134: No Need For Omni Howl

Chapter 7134: No Need For Omni Howl

Spectators saw hope after seeing Ninth Lady’s manifestation of an innate gift.

“Ooo-” A howl came first before cascading moonlight.

Divine Firmament was vast but the moonlight reached every inch of land. It felt as if one were strolling beneath the poetic moonlight, surrounded by the hum of insects and the fragrance of flowers.

However, a terrible divine beast aura suppressed everyone in the blink of an eye - sharp and tyrannical like a monster revealing its snow-white fang.

Sure enough, a wolf claw came for Ninth Lady, capable of slicing the twenty-four firmaments or smashing living beings to pieces.

The attacker was a colossal wolf, as intimidating as could be. All were helpless sheep in its presence. It had a silvery mane cascading downward like waterfalls. Its eyes shone brilliantly like two enormous jade stars.

It emanated a lunar light, standing in stark contrast with its tyrannical and radiant aura. This light was serene and gentle.

“Damn!” Stone Immortal and Chongming Immortal Monarch bellowed.

“Lunar Wolf.” Even ancient ancestors couldn’t move an inch.

Lunar Wolf might not be the strongest among the nine but certainly the most violent. Nonetheless, someone blocked the slash.

“Brother, this is unbecoming of you.” Someone spoke in a peaceful yet commanding manner, blocking Lunar Wolf’s path.

He appeared to be the pinnacle of immortals, always the center of attention. A single thought of his could freeze Divine Firmament.

“Apex Immortal!” Lunar Wolf was surprised to see the opponent - the strongest primordial immortal from Ancient.

Only a few in Heavenrealm could compare to him. For example, Epoch Dawn’s Sheng Shengxian.

“Why is he here?” Chongming Immortal Monarch wondered.

Ninth Lady, Hao Cai, and Apex Immortal had nothing to do with each other, being from Epoch Dawn, Guardian, and Ancient. Now, they appeared to be on the same side.

“This is illogical.” The monarch murmured.

“To save our world?” Stone Immortal said naively.

“No one has time to save others.” The monarch shook his head and spoke the truth.

“Apex, you’ve come to the wrong place. Please leave.” Lunar Wolf said.

“It is where I should be.” Apex said.

“Then this shall be your grave.” Lunar Wolf’s eyes flashed murderously.

“I’ve heard of your famous Omni Howl. I would like to see it.” Apex smiled.

“I don’t need Omni Howl to kill you.” Lunar Wolf said before shooting emerald beams from its eyes.

The beams bounced back and forth with an impossible-to-predict trajectory. They had a petrifying effect, stopping everything in place.
